title: Finite free modules on the condensed point
statement: For a commutative ring object Λ in abelian sheaves on the coherent site of profinite spaces [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data] and n a natural number, pointModelFree Λ n is the existing finite biproduct of n regular Λ-modules [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model], with its internal module category explicitly recorded. This includes the zero-fold biproduct.
